title: The Tutorial's negative depth
description: The player enters the Tutorial cave and pauses: the pause screen gives his depth as -147.60 feet. He walks on, drops into the lower cave and pauses again on its floor, the lowest he can stand, and the depth is still below zero, -82.32 feet.
